questions.question:
What will come in place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '-' and '÷' are interchanged?

16 - 4 + 13 × 5 ÷ 2 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

According to the given question:

 
 

 Symbols
 Interchanged with
 
 

 **+**
 **×**
 
 

 -
 **÷**
 
 

 

Given equation : 16 - 4 + 13 × 5 ÷ 2 = ?

Now if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '-' and '÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ __**16 **____**÷ 4**__ × 13 + 5 - 2 = ?

⇒ __**4 × 13**__ + 5 - 2 = ?

⇒ __**52 + 5**__ - 2 = ?

⇒ __**57 - 2 **__=** 55**.

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 4'.*

52 = 52 (LHS = RHS)

(42 × 3)__ + 1 = 127

__126 ____+ 1__ = 127

127 = 127 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

17 ÷ 9 - 39 + 225 × 15 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

According to the given question:

 
 

 Symbols
 Interchanged with
 
 

 **+**
 **-**
 
 

 -
 **+**
 
 

 ×
 **÷**
 
 

 ÷
 **×**
 
 

 

Given equation : 17 ÷ 9 - 39 + 225 × 15 = ?

Now if '+' and '-' are interchanged with '-' and '+' respectively, and '×' and '÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ 17 × 9 + 39 - 225 ÷ 15 = ?

Using BODMAS rule:

⇒ 17 × 9 + 39 - __**225 ÷ 15** __= ?

⇒ __17 × 9__ + 39 - 15= ?

⇒ __**153 + 39 **__- 15 = ?

⇒ __**192 - 15**__ = 177.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'**.

questions.question:
Seven people, B, N, M, O, P, Y and S are sitting in a straight line, facing south. Only two people sit between P and S. N is the immediate neighbour of S and M. Only one person sits to the right of P. N sits second to the left of O. Y is an immediate neighbour of P.

Total how many people sit between P and M?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Seven people, B, N, M, O, P, Y and S are sitting in a straight line, facing south. 

**Explanation :**

1) Only one person sits to the right of P.

2) Only two people sit between P and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6802fcec51bd1db6149ec11a4ad8acf606492a17290fdd073d72b754f3eab52.png] 

3) N is the immediate neighbour of S and M.

4) N sits second to the left of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c68606cab42faaf505fc3949ecb6edb4cf78e566411d9c9398bae52d670504d8.png] 

5) Y is an immediate neighbour of P.

As position of Y with respect to P is not known yet therefore there are two possible positions for Y.

After positioning Y only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f09d5c46dcd0ee2c0a11d68d0b128383783e30e36b5014cf6678c0bd4a5bd97.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement four people i.e O, S, N and M sit between P and M.

Hence, **"Four"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(5, 11, 80)

(6, 12, 90)

Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Scissors : Cloth
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The first word is an instrument or tool used to act on the second word.**

**For,** Scissors : Cloth

→ Scissors are used to cut Cloth.

Similarly,

**For,** Razor : Beard

Razor is used to shave Beard.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
